lines.text: While it was still dark, Mary Magdalene found the stone removed from the tomb and ran to Simon Peter.
Peter and the other disciple ran to the tomb, and Peter arrived first and went in.

wrong_details.true: the other disciple outran Peter and reached the tomb first

lines.text: The cloth that had been around Jesus' head was rolled up, and the disciples returned to their homes.
Mary wept outside the tomb, saw two angels in white, and then thought Jesus was the guard.
Jesus called her name, and Mary Magdalene told the disciples, "I have seen the Lord!"
